description.zh_CN: 根据 Komari 节点上报的公网 IP，自动更新 Cloudflare DNS 解析记录，实现动态域名解析。
description.en: Automatically update Cloudflare DNS records from the public IP reported by a Komari node, providing dynamic DNS.

help.zh_CN: 需具备 Zone:DNS:Edit 权限的全局 Cloudflare API Token，所有记录共用该 Token
help.en: Global Cloudflare API Token with Zone:DNS:Edit permission, shared by all records.

name.zh_CN: 启用 Telegram 命令轮询（仅限独立机器人）
name.en: Enable Telegram command polling (dedicated bot only)

help.zh_CN: 启用后 DDNS 会独立读取该 Bot 的消息。不要与其他插件共用同一个 Bot Token，否则可能抢走其他插件的命令。
help.en: When enabled, DDNS polls updates for this bot. Do not share the bot token with other plugins or their commands may be consumed.

help.zh_CN: 从 @BotFather 获取。需要先开启上方命令轮询开关；仅给 DDNS 独立使用的机器人填写。
help.en: Get this from @BotFather. Enable command polling above. Use a dedicated bot token for DDNS.

help.zh_CN: 填写允许下发更新指令的 Telegram 个人用户 ID，多个 ID 用英文逗号分隔。更新成功时也会通知这些 ID。
help.en: Comma-separated Telegram personal user IDs allowed to trigger updates. These IDs also receive success notifications.

name.zh_CN: 通过 Telegram 通知更新成功
